args.title: Improve performance and prevent timeouts in the totals endpoint
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The GET /reports/:id/totals endpoint currently times out and uses excessive memory when processing very large reports (~1.6 million transactions). This change proposes optimizing the endpoint to calculate and return only the necessary three numbers per currency directly from the database or in a more efficient manner, reducing memory consumption and avoiding statement timeouts.
